newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Chicago and dollar keep European feeds trade on hold.
newsitem.headline: Chicago and dollar keep European feeds trade on hold.

text.p: A sharply weaker Chicago soymeal futures opening and a higher dollar restricted trade on to only two trades in Argentine sunmeal pellets, dealers said.
Chicago futures dropped to limit-down for new crop material after USDA set U.S. soybean plantings at 70.9 million acres on Monday, the highest since 1982.
"The sharply lower Chicago soycomplex and a strong dollar dampened demand, we only saw last half 1997 sunmeal traded at lower levels," one broker said.
July/Sept Argentine sunmeal pellets traded at $123 a tonne cif Rotterdam and Oct/Dec at $123 a tonne cif.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
